study_identification_part.si4_title: Mapping the Heterogeneous Brain Structural Phenotype of Autism Spectrum Disorder Using the Normative Model

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Combine NMF with normative modeling to quantify individual-level deviations in gray matter structure in ASD relative to typical development and assess whether deviation patterns identify ASD subtypes with distinct clinical features.
